grammarFocus: 现在完成时入门；already / yet / since / for；与一般过去时区分。
title: A New Chapter: Life Changes and Learning
instructions: 本材料为模拟教育练习，并非官方雅思考试。请先听录音（或阅读转录文本），然后完成10道题。题目类型包括单选、填空和判断正误/未提及。填空答案必须与原文完全一致，且不超过字数限制。所有解释均为中文，证据为英文原文引用。
transcript:
Woman: Hi, Mark! I haven't seen you for ages. How have you been?
Man: Lucy! Good to see you. I've been really busy. I've just started a new job at a language school.
Woman: That's great! I've heard you wanted to change jobs for a long time. How long have you been there?
Man: Only for two weeks. But I've already taught three classes. The students are friendly.
Woman: Nice. And have you moved to a new apartment yet?
Man: Yes, I have. I've lived in the new place since last month. It's near the school, so I walk to work.
Woman: That sounds perfect. I've been a teacher for five years now, but I've never worked at a language school. I've always taught at a primary school.
Man: Have you ever thought about changing?
Woman: Well, I've already decided to take a course in teaching English to adults. I haven't started it yet, but I've signed up.
Man: Good for you! I took a similar course three years ago. It helped me a lot.
Woman: Really? How long did it take?
Man: It took six months. I finished it in 2020.
Woman: And have you kept in touch with your classmates since then?
Man: Some of them, yes. I've known one friend since the course. We meet for coffee every month.
Woman: That's nice. I hope I'll make good friends too.
Man: You will. By the way, I've just remembered—there's a free workshop next week. Have you heard about it?
Woman: No, I haven't. Thanks for telling me! I'll check the website.

questions.evidence: I've just started a new job at a language school.

questions.explanation: 男士说“Only for two weeks.”，所以他在新工作的时间是两周。

questions.explanation: 女士问“have you moved to a new apartment yet?”，男士回答“Yes, I have.”，因此他确实搬了。

answers: Take a course in teaching English to adults

grammar.title: 现在完成时入门：already / yet / since / for 与一般过去时的区别
grammar.explanation: 现在完成时（have/has + 过去分词）常用来表示过去发生但与现在有联系的动作或状态。already 用于肯定句，表示“已经”；yet 用于否定句和疑问句，表示“还未”或“已经”；since 后接时间点，表示“自从”；for 后接时间段，表示“持续了多久”。一般过去时（动词过去式）表示过去某个具体时间发生的动作，与现在无关。例如：I have lived here since 2010.（我现在还住这里） vs. I lived there in 2010.（过去住那里，现在不一定）。
grammar.example: I've lived in the new place since last month.

questions.prompt: She ______ her homework. Now she can watch TV.
questions.explanation: 现在完成时结构为 have/has + 过去分词，already 放在 have/has 之后。因此选“has already finished”。
questions.evidence: She has already finished her homework.

questions.explanation: 否定句中用 yet 表示“还未”，现在完成时否定形式为 haven't + 过去分词。因此选“haven't moved; yet”。
questions.evidence: They haven't moved to the new apartment yet.

questions.explanation: since 后接时间点（2010），表示从那时到现在，用现在完成时。因此选“have lived; since”。
questions.evidence: I have lived in this city since 2010.

questions.explanation: 句子中有具体过去时间“in 2020”，应用一般过去时，动词用过去式 finished。

transfer.writing: Write a short paragraph (about 80-100 words) about a change you have made in your life. Use the present perfect with already, yet, since, and for, and the past simple where appropriate. Explain what you have done and how you feel about it.
